aka.zh: 渝湛高速（1992 年国道主干线）

tagline.en: The south-west's road to the sea, from Lanzhou to Haikou, finished in 2024 when the Muzhailing tunnel opened
tagline.zh: 西南出海大通道，自兰州直抵海口，2024 年木寨岭隧道通车后全线贯通

start.en: The Mei'an junction with the Hainan ring expressway, Xiuying District, Haikou — reached by ferry across the Qiongzhou Strait from Xuwen
start.zh: 海南省海口市秀英区美安枢纽，接海南环岛高速——须自徐闻乘轮渡跨琼州海峡

end.en: Yanjiaping East Street, Qilihe District, Lanzhou, Gansu
end.zh: 甘肃省兰州市七里河区晏家坪东街路口

en: G75 runs 2,441 km from Lanzhou to Haikou, down through Gansu, Sichuan, Chongqing, Guizhou, Guangxi and Guangdong to Hainan: Lanzhou, Guangyuan, Nanchong, Chongqing, Zunyi, Guiyang, Majiang, Duyun, Hechi, Nanning, Qinzhou, Beihai, Zhanjiang and Haikou. It leaves the Loess Plateau over the edge of the Tibetan plateau in southern Gansu, drops into the Sichuan basin, climbs the Dalou Shan onto the Guizhou plateau, and comes down through the karst of Guangxi to the Beibu Gulf and the Leizhou peninsula.

It is not continuous road. At Xuwen, the southern tip of the mainland, the route crosses the Qiongzhou Strait by ferry and its mileage is not counted across the water; a fixed crossing is planned. Through Chongqing the route uses the city's Inner Ring expressway, toll-free between the Beibei and Banan toll stations. It shares with G60 from Guiyang to Majiang and with G15 from Zhanjiang to Xuwen and on Hainan; a 2024 plan moves it off G15 on the Leizhou peninsula onto a new western line to Jiaowei, work on which is expected in the 15th Five-Year Plan.
zh: G75 自兰州至海口，全长 2,441 公里，自北向南经甘肃、四川、重庆、贵州、广西、广东至海南，途经兰州、广元、南充、重庆、遵义、贵阳、麻江、都匀、河池、南宁、钦州、北海、湛江、海口。它从黄土高原出发，经甘南青藏高原边缘南下进入四川盆地，翻越大娄山登上贵州高原，再穿过广西喀斯特地区下到北部湾和雷州半岛。
这条路并非连续的路面。在大陆最南端的徐闻，路线以轮渡跨越琼州海峡，海上里程不计；跨海固定通道尚在规划中。在重庆市区，路线借用重庆内环快速路，北碚收费站至巴南收费站之间免费通行。G75 自贵阳至麻江与 G60 沪昆高速共线，自湛江至徐闻及海南境内与 G15 沈海高速共线；依据 2024 年的线位方案，雷州半岛段将不再与 G15 共线，改走西线至徐闻角尾乡，预计“十五五”期间开工。

en: Its last piece was its hardest. The Muzhailing tunnel on the Weiyuan–Wudu section, between Min and Zhang counties in Gansu, is 15,226 m (left) and 15,160 m (right) long, two lanes each way at up to 80 km/h, with up to about 629 m of cover, under the divide between the Zhang and Tao river systems. It runs through carbonaceous slate that turns to sand in air and mud in water, across six folds and twelve major fault zones, all in the weakest rock class and under very high ground stress. In the inclined access shafts the rock squeezed in by as much as 3,145 mm and almost a third of the arches had to be torn out and replaced. A team led by academicians Sun Jun and He Manchao introduced constant-resistance (NPR) and yielding anchor cables; a job planned for 55 months took nearly eight years. At its opening it was China's fourth-longest road tunnel.

Further south, the Chongxihe–Zunyi section in Guizhou, 117.88 km, has 84 bridges totalling 22.2 km and 17 tunnels totalling 18.7 km, 35% of its length. Its key work, the Liangfengya tunnel, 4,085 m in each bore, passes through karst, underground rivers, fault zones and gas-bearing ground. In Chongqing, the Hechuan–Chongqing section crosses the Jialing River three times and has five tunnels; in Sichuan, the 55.49 km from the Gansu border to Guangyuan has three extra-long tunnels and six extra-large bridges.
zh: 最后一段最难。渭武高速木寨岭特长隧道位于甘肃岷县与漳县交界，左线 15,226 米、右线 15,160 米，双向四车道，最高设计时速 80 公里，最大埋深约 629 米，横穿漳河与洮河两大水系的分水岭。隧道穿越炭质板岩，岩石遇风成沙、遇水成泥，地层夹有 6 处褶皱和 12 条大断层破碎带，均为五级围岩，属极高地应力区。斜井施工中最大变形达 3,145 毫米，拆换拱率达 32.4%。孙钧、何满潮两位院士团队引入 NPR 恒阻锚索和让压锚索支护体系；原计划 55 个月的工期最终用了近 8 年。通车时为中国第四长公路隧道。
再往南，贵州崇溪河至遵义段全长 117.88 公里，桥梁 84 座、长 22.2 公里，隧道 17 座、长 18.7 公里，桥隧占路线总长的 35%。控制性工程凉风垭隧道左右洞各长 4,085 米，穿越岩溶、暗河、断层破碎带和瓦斯地段。重庆境内，合川至重庆段三跨嘉陵江，设隧道 5 座；四川境内，川甘界至广元 55.49 公里有特长隧道 3 座、特大桥 6 座。

en: The middle came first, as a road to the sea for the south-west. The 1992 national trunk highway plan included G050, Chongqing to Zhanjiang. In 2000 the Ministry of Communications named eight western inter-provincial corridors, among them Lanzhou to Mohan on the Laos border, whose northern part is today's G75, and Baotou to Beihai, whose southern part also became G75. The 2005 national expressway plan joined these into Lanzhou–Haikou.

Chongqing built its 134 km to the Guizhou border in two stages, opening Tongjiayuanzi–Leishendian on 1 October 2001 and Leishendian–Chongxihe on 29 December 2004; Hechuan–Chongqing opened in June 2002. Guizhou's Chongxihe–Zunyi, studied from 1991 and begun on 1 July 2002, opened on 26 December 2005; described as the last link of the Chongqing–Zhanjiang corridor, it replaced National Highway 210 over the Liangfengya pass at 1,450 m and its seventy-two bends. Nanchong–Chongqing opened on 20 November 2008, Guangyuan–Nanchong on 1 April 2012 and the Gansu-border road on 19 December 2012.

Gansu took longest. The Weiyuan–Wudu section, 238 km, was begun in 2016; its Longnan part opened on 1 January 2020 and its Dingxi part on 1 January 2021 except for the Muzhailing tunnel, around which traffic detoured over the 3,000 m Muzhailing pass on National Highway 212. The tunnel was holed through on 6 July 2023 and opened at midnight on 31 January 2024, which Gansu Daily and Xinhua reported as the completion of G75. The Haikou section, 13.727 km shared with G15, had opened on 28 December 2022.
zh: 中段最早建成，作为西南的出海通道。1992 年国道主干线规划中有 G050 渝湛线，自重庆至广东湛江。2000 年交通部提出八条西部省际通道，其中兰州至中老边境磨憨口岸一线的北段即今 G75 北段，包头至北海一线的南段也成为 G75 的一部分。2005 年国家高速公路网规划将其合为兰州至海口高速。

重庆境内至渝黔界 134 公里分两期建设：童家院子至雷神店于 2001 年 10 月 1 日通车，雷神店至崇溪河于 2004 年 12 月 29 日通车；合川至重庆段于 2002 年 6 月通车。贵州崇遵高速自 1991 年开始论证，2002 年 7 月 1 日开工，2005 年 12 月 26 日通车；它被称为渝湛通道的最后攻坚路段，取代了 210 国道翻越海拔 1,450 米凉风垭、号称“七十二道拐”的老路。南渝高速于 2008 年 11 月 20 日通车，广南高速于 2012 年 4 月 1 日通车，广甘高速于 2012 年 12 月 19 日通车。

甘肃段耗时最长。渭源至武都段全长 238 公里，2016 年开工；陇南段于 2020 年 1 月 1 日通车，定西段除木寨岭特长隧道外于 2021 年 1 月 1 日通车，车辆须经 212 国道翻越海拔 3,000 多米的木寨岭绕行。隧道于 2023 年 7 月 6 日贯通，2024 年 1 月 31 日零时通车，《甘肃日报》与新华网报道 G75 由此实现全线贯通运营。此前，与 G15 共线的海口段 13.727 公里已于 2022 年 12 月 28 日通车。

en: No cost for the whole road has been published. The most expensive section on record is the last: the Weiyuan–Wudu road was estimated at 38.041 billion yuan for 238 km, about 160 million yuan a kilometre, invested and built by the Gansu Provincial Highway Aviation Tourism Investment Group, a provincial state company. Guizhou's Chongxihe–Zunyi section is reported at 6.9 billion yuan, including a US$200 million Asian Development Bank loan, and Chongqing's Hechuan–Chongqing section at 3.1 billion.
zh: 全线没有公布过总造价。有记录的路段中最贵的是最后建成的一段：渭源至武都高速全长 238 公里，概算总投资 380.41 亿元，折合每公里约 1.6 亿元，由甘肃省属国企甘肃省公路航空旅游投资集团投资建设。贵州崇遵段据报道总投资 69 亿元，其中利用亚洲开发银行贷款 2 亿美元；重庆合川至重庆段工程总投资 31 亿元。

en: The Muzhailing tunnel cut the 30 km between the Dacaotan and Meichuan toll stations from nearly an hour and a half over the pass to a little over twenty minutes. In Guizhou, the Chongxihe–Zunyi road turned what had been three to four hours over the old passes into under an hour. At the far end, the last stretch is a ferry: from Xuwen port to Haikou, after which the free road runs to the Mei'an junction.

The worst crash on record is at the northern end. On 3 November 2018, about 200 m before the Lanzhou South toll station, a lorry heading for the city lost control and ploughed through the toll plaza traffic, killing 15 people, injuring 44 and damaging 31 vehicles.
zh: 木寨岭隧道通车后，大草滩至梅川收费站之间 30 公里，由翻山近一个半小时缩短为 20 多分钟。贵州崇遵高速通车后，经过老路几道险关原本要三四个小时，如今用不了一个小时。最南端的最后一程是轮渡：自徐闻港渡海至海口，上岸后经免费路段至美安枢纽。
有记录的最严重事故发生在北端。2018 年 11 月 3 日，在距兰州南收费站约 200 米处，一辆驶往兰州方向的货车失控冲向收费站车流，造成 15 人死亡、44 人受伤、31 辆车受损。

why.en: No total has been published. Seven provinces financed their own sections over more than two decades, from Chongqing's first stage in 2001 to Gansu's Muzhailing tunnel in 2024; the sourced section costs are given separately below.
why.zh: 全线总造价未见公布。沿线七省区市在二十多年间分别为境内路段筹资，从 2001 年重庆一期到 2024 年甘肃木寨岭隧道；已查到出处的路段造价另列如下。

value.en: Estimated at 38.041 billion yuan for 238 km

timeline.en: Chongqing's Tongjiayuanzi–Leishendian section, the first 87 km towards Guizhou, opens on 1 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 1 日，重庆童家院子至雷神店段约 87 公里通车，为通往贵州的第一段。

timeline.en: Leishendian–Chongxihe opens on 29 December, bringing the road to the Guizhou border.
timeline.zh: 12 月 29 日，雷神店至崇溪河段通车，接至贵州界。

timeline.en: Chongxihe–Zunyi opens on 26 December, completing the Chongqing–Zhanjiang corridor to the sea.
timeline.zh: 12 月 26 日，崇遵高速通车，渝湛出海通道全线贯通。
11 月 20 日，南渝高速全线通车。

timeline.en: Guangyuan–Nanchong opens on 1 April and the road from Guangyuan to the Gansu border on 19 December.
timeline.zh: 4 月 1 日广南高速全线通车；12 月 19 日广甘高速通车。

timeline.en: Work begins on the Weiyuan–Wudu section in Gansu, including the Muzhailing tunnel.
timeline.zh: 甘肃渭武高速（含木寨岭隧道）开工。

timeline.en: A runaway lorry near the Lanzhou South toll station kills 15 on 3 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 3 日，兰州南收费站附近一辆货车失控，造成 15 人死亡。

timeline.en: The Longnan part of Weiyuan–Wudu opens on 1 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 1 日，渭武高速陇南段通车。

timeline.en: The Haikou section, shared with G15, opens on 28 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 28 日，与 G15 共线的海口段通车。

timeline.en: The Muzhailing tunnel opens on 31 January, and G75 is reported complete.
timeline.zh: 1 月 31 日木寨岭特长隧道通车，兰海高速宣告全线贯通运营。
